sentences.text:
. (Presently Confined In Sub Jail Kishangarh Bas Alwar)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, through PP  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Harendra Singh through VC For State : Mr. Mangal Singh Saini, PP HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PANKAJ BHANDARI Order 07/09/2020 1.

Petitioner has filed third bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.
2.
F.I.R. No.503/2019 was registered at Police Station Kishangarh Bas, District Alwar for offence under Sections 420, 270, 272, 273 of I.P.C. and Section 5 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
3. It is contended by counsel for the petitioner that charges have been framed.
Offence is triable by First Class Magistrate.
Offence under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is bailable.
It is contended that petitioner has remained in custody for a period of nine months.
4. Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed third bail application.
6. Considering the contentions put forth by counsel for the petitioner, I deem it proper to allow third bail application.

7. Third bail application is accordingly allowed and it is directed that accused petitioner shall be released on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) together with two sureties in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation that he shall appear before that Court Sorab Khan S/O Kareem Khan vs State Of Rajasthan on 7 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57540403/
1 and any court to which the matter is transferred, on all subsequent dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

sentences.text: 8. However, it is made clear that if the petitioner repeats the offence, State would be free to move application for cancellation of bail before the concerned Court.

9. A copy of this order be sent to concerned S.H.O. for recording this condition in the Village Crime Record Book so that in the event of petitioner's repeating offence, S.H.O. can move the Court for cancellation of bail.
